body:
Founder real-time, direct follow-up to S479: 'we need an actual object builder building a door as a level doesnt make any sense i need an actual door that is a door so i know what direction to stick it on stuff etc - we can clone doors and edit the geometry etc just like objects but its too weird.' Confirmed via AskUserQuestion: chose to extend the existing recursive flattening (which already composes walls/materials) to also carry doors through, rather than build a separate first-class Door object type. Root cause, confirmed directly in code: flattenObjects never carried a composed object's own doors through at all -- only walls/materials/friction -- so a level authored as a reusable 'door room' and placed as an Object elsewhere (the exact same way every other reusable structure already works) could never actually carry a working door. The founder's own workaround (clone-then-edit a door level per placement) never solved this. Fix: flattenObjects now returns a second value, []composedDoorRef -- doors expressed as an index into the []Wall the same call returns (real Door IDs are meaningless mid-flatten since a wall's final position in the combined walls[] isn't known until Export finishes appending every object's contribution). Export translates these into real final box_index values and merges with root doors via a new shared doorExportFor helper (extracted from doorsForExport so the ScriptID==0 -> empty ScriptURL handling can't drift between the two paths). New TestExport_ComposedObjectCarriesDoor verifies a door on a child level's own wall (deliberately non-sequential WallID) survives composition with the correct final box_index. go build/test ./... clean (full suite, not just the touched package). Also gave the founder concrete, grounded dimension/orientation guidance directly in chat: a door has no shape of its own (it's a wall block that moves 1000 units down when open, not a swinging panel), so it must be sized to actually plug the gap you want it to open (>=2 wide, >=7 tall given PLAYER_HEIGHT=6.47, matching wall thickness) -- and there is no orientation/facing concept, it opens by proximity alone. Commits: 01d11a6 (fix+test), c432725 (changelog). Deployed live (iduna.service restarted, health check passed).

⚓ ☃
title: S479 follow-up: doors compose through embedded level objects
